prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right tool depends on what you need (type of ad, budget, channels, speed, branding control). Below are the top options by common use case and a short buying checklist so you can pick quickly.

Quick recommendations (by use case)
- Best for AI presenters / talking-head ads: Synthesia
  - Pros: realistic AI avatars, many languages, good for product demos and training-style ads.
  - Cons: costlier, less flexible for flashy motion graphics.
- Best for fast social ads + templates: Canva or InVideo
  - Pros: easy templates, formats for all ad sizes, basic AI text and voice features, low learning curve.
  - Cons: not as advanced for automated long-to-short repurposing.
- Best for repurposing long videos into short ads: Opus Clip, Vidyo.ai, or Pictory
  - Pros: auto-clip detection, captioning, hook creation for Shorts/Reels/TikTok.
  - Cons: sometimes needs manual polishing.
- Best for advanced generative / creative effects: Runway
  - Pros: state-of-the-art generative video tools, advanced editing and effects.
  - Cons: learning curve, suited for creative visuals rather than quick ad templates.
- Best for e‑commerce / high-conversion ad templates: Shakr or Promo.com
  - Pros: built for product ads, motion templates, platform-optimized assets.
  - Cons: less “AI presenter” capability.
- Best budget / free-friendly: CapCut and Canva Free
  - Pros: powerful free features, native vertical formats, quick edits.
  - Cons: fewer enterprise features and advanced AI.
- Best for image/copy + ad optimization (supplement to video maker): AdCreative.ai
  - Pros: generates ad copy/variants and creatives you can pair with video assets.
  - Cons: focused on copy & static creatives; video support varies.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Target platform(s): TikTok/Reels need vertical, <15s friendly hooks; YouTube needs 16:9 and longer formats.
- Format: talking head vs animated text + B-roll vs stylized generative visuals.
- Time-to-market: need something instant (templates) or willing to iterate (Runway/R&D)?
- Branding: strict brand kit and custom fonts/colors?
- Languages/Voiceover: multi-language TTS and lip-synced avatars needed?
- Budget & scale: single ads vs dozens per campaign (automation & bulk rendering).
- Team features: collaboration, asset library, revision history, team seats.

My suggestion
- If you want a fast, practical choice: try Canva Pro or InVideo (templates + easy export).
- If you need professional AI presenters: test Synthesia (free demo + paid).
- If you need to turn long videos into many short ads fast: try Opus Clip or Vidyo.ai.

If you tell me:
- where you’ll run the ads (TikTok, Facebook, YouTube),
- your typical ad length and style (talking head, product shots, animated text),
- budget (free / <$50/month / enterprise),
I’ll recommend the top 2–3 tools for your exact needs and one workflow to get an ad live quickly.
